package.description: 网易云音乐一站式任务管理工具。

en-US.description: One-stop task management tool for NetEase Cloud Music.
en-US.longDescription: ncmm is a Go-based one-stop task management tool for NetEase Cloud Music, offering both a command line interface and a WebUI. It covers daily check-ins, cloud coins and growth-value tasks, musician tasks, song plays, posts, daily song recommendations, membership gifts, and fan-group check-ins, and provides multi-account management, scheduled jobs, earnings statistics, run logs, and failure notifications.

zh-CN.description: 网易云音乐一站式任务管理工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: ncmm 是一个基于 Go 开发的网易云音乐一站式任务管理工具，同时提供命令行与 WebUI。支持日常签到、云贝与成长值任务、音乐人任务、歌曲播放、图文动态、每日推歌、会员礼品和乐迷团打卡，并提供多账号管理、定时调度、收益统计、运行日志与失败通知。
zh-CN.name: ncmm
